title: A cloud page whose sign-in ends after a log-off in another tab says only 'Not synced yet.'
evidence: Found in the C31 review (PR 1462), by code reading; not reproduced in a browser. A log-off in another tab clears this device's cloud sign-in and stops this page's device writes (US-09 AC2c). A cloud page keeps saving to its cloud with the sign-in it holds in memory, so it shows no stopped notice (US-09 AC2i). Once that sign-in needs a refresh, the refresh finds the stored grant gone and drops it (widget-src/src/storage/dropbox.ts:343-385 dropIfGrantMoved; US-09 AC2f says the same for Drive), so every later save fails. The storage bar then says only 'Not synced yet.' (storageBarLabel, widget-src/standalone/sync-control.tsx:97,117): the device copy is refused, so it never reaches 'Not synced yet. Your changes are on this device.' Nothing tells the person to reload or sign in again. A reload opens the page as whatever this browser now is (the log-off forgot the cloud), and the edits made since the sign-in ended, held only in this page's memory, are lost. Any notice here needs words.
